what: ggsegJHU: JHU White Matter Atlases for the 'ggseg' Ecosystem — ggsegJHU-package
title: ggsegJHU: JHU White Matter Atlases for the 'ggseg' Ecosystem — ggsegJHU-package
text: JHU ICBM white matter atlases 'ggseg' ecosystem. Includes JHU probabilistic tracts (Hua et al. 2008), ICBM-DTI-81 white matter labels (Mori et al. 2005), ICBM tract meshes. Provides unified 'ggseg_atlas' objects 3D mesh geometry, use 'ggseg3d'.
